notes.title: Bright Memory 1.0 release!
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Bright Memory!
[h3]Today, Bright Memory will be leaving early access. 
From now on development focus will shift completely to the next title Bright Memory: Infinite.[/h3]
[h3] The title will be on sale for one week to celebrate its exit from early access, after which the price will be set at $9.99.[/h3]
Now, the game may be leaving early access but those that purchase Bright Memory will still receive Bright Memory: Infinite free of charge upon release.

notes.title: Bright Memory Early Access Version 20/01/2020 Update Details
notes.notes:
[h3]Dear Bright Memory users,
In the RTX update that went live on the 15th January we needed to update Unreal Engine 4, however, we realized Unreal Engine 4.2 23.1 does not support DX 11. The issue was fixed with a patch on the official Unreal Engine GitHub which now means DX 11 is supported and that Windows 7 users are now able to play Bright Memory.[/h3]

[h3]Notes:[/h3]
[b]・If your graphics card does not support RTX, please select the “DX 11 option” that pops up on start up.[/b]
・The “DX12 option” is for experiencing real time ray tracing. You may experience a temporary drop in frame rate.

20/01/2020 Update Details
Fixed: Windows 7 support, various bugs.
Fixed: Rendering Resolution Settings
Added: Options for DX11 and DX12 on start up.
Optimized: If DLSS is turned on, Rendering Resolution Settings will be turned off automatically. *This is due to bugs occurring if both are set to ON.

[h3]DLSS Effect Comparison. 50% Framerate Increase[/h3]
・Anti-Aliasing OFF, FXAA X8, TAA X8, DLSS
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34197373/beff004513fd5679e0f4799b87c8e497ace63066.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34197373/47f9f9add229a7480f2319d7a2ea1ece8017f7ed.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Bright Memory Early Access Ver.: 1/15/2020 Update Info
notes.notes:
[h3]Today we released an updated version featuring real-time ray tracing support.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34197373/25ffbc362b64e1014c85825becf7d367a0473745.png[/img]

In August 2018, we released a trailer introducing (at the time) forthcoming real-time ray tracing features. Now, thanks to the technical support of Nvidia and the magic of DLSS technology, we are proud to be able to provide players with a gaming experience featuring both improved graphics quality and even more optimal real-time ray tracing awesomeness.
In order to realize such high-quality real-time ray tracing effects, the current build only supports RTX series graphics cards. While this latest update is still playable using a GTX series graphics card, real-time ray tracing is not supported using said cards. We plan to offer support for some GTX series cards with future updates. When real-time ray tracing is enabled, simultaneously enabling DLSS will help to further improve performance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34197373/144c0207e0d56e6171b4fd4a6aea7a5e504cb59a.png[/img]

[b]The DLSS included in this latest [i]Bright Memory Early Access Ver.[/i] is the latest iteration available from Nvidia, and may differ from versions available in some previous games. This latest version greatly improves finely detailed graphic quality.[/b]

[h3]Real-time ray tracing features in [i]Bright Memory Early Access Ver.[/i] requires the following:[/h3]
１．Windows 10 (ver. 1903 or later)
２．Latest version of the Nvidia graphics driver
３．RTX series graphics card with at least 6GB of video memory
４．PC with "DX12" installed
CAUTION: When configuring graphics settings, your graphics card will check whether RTX real-time ray tracing is supported. This check will require up to ten seconds to perform. If supported, RTX settings will be displayed in the settings menu. If RTX settings are not displayed, please check to be sure that all of the above-listed requirements are met.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34197373/9e6e2259d80ab8726ac454f1c0821141c2ed9c27.png[/img]

[h3]Update Contents[/h3]

[b]Additions[/b]
-Real-time ray tracing effects
-Latest DLSS technology

Optimization
-Improved ACP-Super Submachine Gun feedback while aiming down the sights.
(In the current version, screen shake has been minimized as it had negative effects on the feedback. We have optimized the screen shake for a better user experience.)
-Improved/fixed ACP-Super Submachine Gun recoil mechanics.
[/list]
*Depth of field is not currently functioning correctly. This will be fixed in a later update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34197373/8b3c8fdb052f6811a8f2c7e761c2987a17533d05.png[/img]

notes.title: Bright Memory: Infinite RTX Tech Demo Update Live!
notes.notes:
As was announced the other day, in order for Bright Memory Early Access version owners to experience the Bright Memory: Infinite RTX tech demo, we have added it in an update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34197373/b10db5e4bdc14a9f0c497e2c177031b28f09929f.jpg[/img]

It is possible to select whether to start the Bright Memory Early Access version or the Bright Memory: Infinite RTX tech demo from the Steam client. The controls are simple, right click to pause and left click the the RTX toggle menu in the bottom right of the screen to toggle RTX on and off. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34197373/a7e94646aa8a4bbcba7f892f68d35fc1e4772575.png[/img]

The Bright Memory: Infinite RTX tech demo uses several RTX technologies such as RT Reflection, RT Shadows, RT Global Illumination, and RT Ambient Occlusion. The demo should run at 4K 60FPS with an RTX 2080 graphics card.

As a reminder, the tech demo is merely to demonstrate RTX technology, any characters, locations, enemies or story elements may or may not appear in the final product.

If you are a member of the master race and your PC can handle it please do check out the Bright Memory: Infinite tech demo!

Before that though, we hope you enjoy the updated Bright Memory early access version which has become even more well polished with the addition of great voice acting and localisations.

Thank you all for your continued support.

notes.title: Bright Memory Early Access Version Major Update Goes Live November 20th!
notes.notes:
To all current and future Bright Memory fans,

Nice to meet you, we are indie game publisher PLAYISM.
This stunning indie title with its gorgeous environments and refreshing FPS combo action was developed by a single, self-taught, Chinese youth and quite frankly we were blown away by how highly polished it was when we were first came across it.

As an indie game publisher, we felt like if there was anything we could do to help we would jump at the opportunity and so we flew over to China to meet with the developer and discuss the future of the project. After speaking with him it was decided that we would support Bright Memory and also the future full release, Bright Memory: Infinite, as publisher for all territories excluding China.

Although Bright Memory: Infinite is still in development we immediately set about working on the PR and localization of the early access version of the game. This update brings with it full Japanese and English voice overs as well as Japanese subtitles and brushed up English subtitles and menus.

We will continue supporting this project to the best of our ability in order to draw out the full potential of the developer and game so we can provide the best gaming experience for those who already love the game and for those that are yet to play.

Thank you for your support.

[previewyoutube=s73I1DaHnqM;full][/previewyoutube]

Below is some information regarding the voice actors.

[b]Japanese Voice Actors[/b]
Shelia: Ishikawa Yui
Wake/Soldier A: Tanaka Fumiya

It was an honor being asked to play the part of the main character, Shelia. I hope you all enjoy playing it!”
